name: The Hall
summary: The Victory Road hub, with portals to areas that are not worlds or raids.

name: Prestige Tower
summary: Climb floors in 4v4 battles. Prestige luck grows every 100 floors.

name: Infinite
summary: An endless battle mode that drops cards and items.

name: Echo Depths
summary: A roguelike dungeon mode with 6 zones, reached from [[place:the-hall]].

name: The Junkyard
summary: Home of the [[place:recycler]] and the [[place:scrap-shop]]. Connected to the [[place:science-lab]].

name: Recycler
summary: Turns items and materials into [[currency:scrap]]. The rate is poor, so it is not recommended.

name: Scrap Shop
summary: A levelled shop. Levels cost scrap, there is a daily XP cap, and each level unlocks new stock.

levels.label: Recycler unlock
levels.detail: The [[place:recycler]] is unlocked through the Scrap Shop. TODO(which level)

name: Pack Upgrader
summary: Rolling on a pack earns XP toward levelling it. Each level multiplies that pack's card stats.

name: Archivist
summary: Sells run boosts and buffs to your Echo Mark and Echo Core gains.
stock: TODO(every boost and buff, its effect and its price)

name: Shard Fuser
summary: Fuse 15 zone shards to unlock that zone's special card. Also the main use of Echo Cores.

name: Kaiju Raid
summary: A raid that rewards four Kaiju currencies.

name: Kaiju Raid Shop
summary: The only place to spend Kaiju Raid currencies. Sells potions, items, relics, and unlocks for rolling the raid enemies' cards.

name: Shadow Garden Raid
summary: The same raid format as the Kaiju Raid, reskinned, with a better shop.

name: Shadow Market
summary: The Shadow Garden Raid shop. Sells Weather Rerolls, Raid Potions, Fortune Draughts, 2 relics and raid card unlocks.
